# Read the coefficients
```{r}
rhats <- readRDS(glue("{dirs$rhats}/all_rhats.rds"))
waic_df <- readRDS(glue("{dirs$waic}/all_waic.rds")) %>%
  filter(mod_out == "imm") %>%
  group_by(pat) %>%
  mutate(minwaic = min(waic) == waic)

coef_df <- bind_rows(lapply(str_subset(list.files(glue("{dirs$rhats}"), full.names = TRUE), 
                            "all|archiv|spos", negate = TRUE), readRDS)) %>%
  left_join(rhats, by = join_by(mod)) %>%
  left_join(select(waic_df, mod, pat, pat_tidy, mod_name, vac, minwaic), by = join_by(mod)) %>%
  rename(estimate = Estimate, se = Est.Error, ci95_l = 'l-95% CI' , ci95_u = 'u-95% CI') %>%
  filter(Rhat_cond) %>%
  select(-c(Rhat, Bulk_ESS, Tail_ESS, Rhat_cond)) %>%
  mutate(
    imm_name = str_extract(coefficient, "(?<=immvals1anti)[^_]+"),
    coefficient = case_when(
      !is.na(imm_name) ~ str_remove_all(str_remove_all(coefficient, imm_name), 
                                        "immvals1anti_|\\.\\.\\.[0-9]+$|_immvals1anti"),
      .default = coefficient),
    reg = case_when(str_detect(mod_name, "reg") ~ str_remove_all(mod_name, "csi_")),
    clu = case_when(
      str_detect(coefficient, "reg") ~ str_remove_all(
        coefficient, "reg_[0-9]|:cospi_vac_week_v1|:sinpi_vac_week_v1")),
    coefficient = case_when(
      str_detect(coefficient, "cospi") ~ "cos",
      str_detect(coefficient, "sinpi") ~ "sin",
      str_detect(coefficient, "reg") ~ reg,
      .default = coefficient), 
    clu = case_when(
      coefficient %in% c("cos", "sin") & is.na(clu) & str_detect(reg, "reg_2") ~ "1_North",
      coefficient %in% c("cos", "sin") & is.na(clu) & str_detect(reg, "reg_3|reg_4|reg_6") ~ "1_Temperate",
      .default = clu)) %>%
  select(mod, imm_name, reg, clu, everything())
```

# Cosinor only 
```{r}
pat_sel <- c("rota", "hav", "hbv", "dipht", "tetan", "pertuapt", "pertuwpt", "ipv1", "hib", "menc", 
             "strep04", "measl", "mumps", "rubel", "vzv")

coef_df %>%
  filter(coefficient %in% c("cos", "sin"))

# Plot it 
coef_df %>%
  filter(pat %in% pat_sel) %>%
  filter(coefficient %in% c("cos", "sin")) %>%
  #filter(reg == "reg_4") %>%
  filter(minwaic == TRUE) %>%
  mutate(sig = !(ci95_l <= 0 & ci95_u >= 0)) %>%
  group_by(pat, reg, clu) %>%
  mutate(sig_tot = any(sig == TRUE)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(y = clu, x = estimate, color = sig_tot)) + 
  geom_point() +
  geom_linerange(aes(xmin = ci95_l, xmax = ci95_u)) +
  geom_vline(aes(xintercept = 0)) +
  facet_wrap(pat*imm_name~., scales = "free", ncol = 3) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("grey", "forestgreen")) + 
  theme(strip.text.y = element_text(angle = 0))

# Estimate amplitude and phase
coef_cosin_df <- coef_df %>%
  filter(coefficient %in% c("cos", "sin")) %>%
  select(-c(se, ci95_l, ci95_u)) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = coefficient, values_from = c(estimate), names_prefix = "p_") %>%
  mutate(
    amp = sqrt((p_cos^2) + (p_sin^2)),
    # Periodic phi in radians
    periodic_phi = case_when(
      p_cos > 0 ~ atan((-1*p_sin)/(p_cos)),
      p_cos < 0 ~ atan((-1*p_sin)/(p_cos)) - pi),
    # Periodic phi in weeks
    periodic_phi_week = 52*(periodic_phi*-1)/(2*pi)) %>%
  # Estimate phi 
  mutate(
    phi = case_when(
      periodic_phi_week < 0 ~ periodic_phi_week + 52,
      periodic_phi_week > 0 ~ periodic_phi_week,
      periodic_phi_week == 0 ~ 0),
    phi = case_when(phi > 0 & phi < 1 ~ 52, .default = phi)) %>%
  select(-c(periodic_phi, periodic_phi_week))
```

# Extract coefficients for the cosinor =============================================================  
```{r}
# Extract coefficients for the cosinor and obtain amplitude and phase
coef_cosine_l <- lapply(coef_l, function(x) rownames_to_column(x$fixed, var = "parameter")) %>%
  bind_rows(.id = "mod") %>%
  # Coefficients of the cosinor only 
  filter(str_detect(parameter, "cos|sin")) %>%
  mutate(param = case_when(str_detect(parameter, "cos") ~ "p_cos",
                           str_detect(parameter, "sin") ~ "p_sin")) %>%
  # Attach pathogen and reg 
  left_join(select(df_converged, -Rhat), by = join_by(mod)) %>%
  # Extract the imm_name and clu from the parameter name
  mutate(
    imm_name = str_extract(parameter, "(?<=immvals1anti)[^_]+"),
    clu = str_remove_all(parameter, "reg|_2|_3|_4|_6|cospi_vac_week_v1|sinpi_vac_week_v1|:|immvals1anti|_gauss"),
    clu = case_when(!is.na(imm_name) ~ str_remove_all(clu, imm_name), .default = clu),
    clu = sub("^_", "", clu),
    clu = case_when(
      str_detect(reg, "reg_2") & clu == "" ~ "1_North",
      str_detect(reg, "reg_3|reg_4|reg_6") & clu == "" ~ "1_Temperate",
      !is.na(reg) & clu != "" ~ clu)) %>%
  select(pathogen, mod, param, reg, clu, imm_name, Estimate) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = param, values_from = Estimate) %>%
  # Estimate amplitude and phase
  mutate(
    amp = sqrt((p_cos^2) + (p_sin^2)),
    # Periodic phi in radians
    periodic_phi = case_when(
      p_cos > 0 ~ atan((-1*p_sin)/(p_cos)),
      p_cos < 0 ~ atan((-1*p_sin)/(p_cos)) - pi),
    # Periodic phi in weeks
    periodic_phi_week = 52*(periodic_phi*-1)/(2*pi)) %>%
  # Estimate phi empirically 
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(phi_emp = which(p_cos*cos(2*pi*(1:52)/52) + p_sin*sin(2*pi*(1:52)/52) == 
                           max(p_cos*cos(2*pi*(1:52)/52) + p_sin*sin(2*pi*(1:52)/52)))) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  # Estimate phi 
  mutate(
    phi = case_when(
      periodic_phi_week < 0 ~ periodic_phi_week + 52,
      periodic_phi_week > 0 ~ periodic_phi_week,
      periodic_phi_week == 0 ~ 0),
    phi = case_when(phi > 0 & phi < 1 ~ 52, .default = phi)) %>%
  # Create column for waic over baseline model or not
  mutate(minwaic = !(pathogen %in% df_minwaic[str_detect(df_minwaic$mod, "base"),]$pathogen))

saveRDS(coef_cosine_l, glue("{dirs$outputs}/modres_coef_cosine.rds"))
```

# Plot conditional effects 
```{r}
clu_name <- "reg_6"

dat_plot <- ce_dat_l[str_subset(names(ce_dat_l), clu_name)] %>%
  bind_rows(.id = "mod") %>%
  left_join(df_converged) %>%
  mutate(pathogen_imm = glue("{pathogen}_{imm_name}")) %>%
  group_by(pathogen, pathogen_imm, clu) %>%
  filter(clu_checkgaps == FALSE) %>%
  mutate(clu = str_remove_all(clu, " ")) %>%
  left_join(filter(coef_cosine_l, str_detect(reg, clu_name))) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(phase_group = case_when(
    phi >= 6 & phi < 20 ~ "2spring",
    phi >= 20 & phi < 33 ~ "3summer",
    phi >= 33 & phi < 46 ~ "4autumn",
    phi < 6 | phi >= 46 ~ "1winter"))
```
